content.short: Aeoniumsky is a psychedelic ride into the unexpected.
content.description:
Aeoniumsky is an art based NFT project only on Cardano. The core project follows Series 01 of the BLOCKS – an interconnecting animated illustration made up of 24 BLOCKS(3x8 BLOCKS).

Each BLOCK captures moments in time in the NFT space and aeonsphere to form a never ending digital tapestry.
